verdict.rationale: Mastra ships an official `@mastra/mcp-docs-server` MCP server that exposes its documentation via MCP and is documented to work with Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Claude Code, VS Code, and Codex, and the framework also supports authoring MCP servers that expose agents/tools/resources. This directly satisfies connecting an agent via an official MCP server, though evidence is entirely first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the MCP server actually working, and more detail on the agent-exposing MCP server (mastra-gh-6) beyond a one-line feature claim.
